meta.tagline: Raids, eggs & Team GO Rocket — CPs, shinies, and lineups at a glance.

callout.text: LIVE since Wed 28 Oct 6:00 AM local: Giratina (Origin) 5★ (through Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM) + Mega Sableye (through Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM) + standard 3★ Cofagrigus / Trevenant / Dhelmise (GO Hub). Halloween 2026 Part I costume 1★ still LIVE through Sun 1 Nov 10:00 AM: Pikachu wearing a hat and capelet + Sinistea wearing a bow (shiny debuts). Shadow Landorus (Incarnate) + Shadow 1★/3★ continue through Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM. Raid Hour tonight Wed 28 Oct 6:00–7:00 PM local: denser Giratina (Origin) 5★. ENDED Tue 27 Oct 10:00 PM: Palkia 5★ + Mega Charizard X & Y + dragon 1★ + Alolan 3★. Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day Sat 31 Oct 2–5 PM.
callout.endsAtLabel: Halloween costume 1★ → Sun 1 Nov 10:00 AM · Giratina (Origin) → Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM · Mega Sableye → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM · Shadow Landorus → Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM · Raid Hour Wed 28 Oct 6–7 PM · Chandelure SMRD Sat 31 Oct 2–5 PM
